deals.evidence: AZ komt voor maximaal vijf procent in Amerikaanse handen.
deals.headline: Billy Beane buys a minority stake of up to 5% in AZ
deals.summary: AZ agreed a deal under which up to five percent of the club passes to Billy Beane, its adviser on sporting policy and innovation since 2015; the board chair said it showed the club was open to outside financing. The accounts record the shares as issued to WLBIII LLC on exercise of an option, with a put/call arrangement.

deals.date_text: July 2025 (decision); completion after adoption of the 2024/25 accounts
deals.evidence: In juli 2025 heeft aandeelhouder Billy Beane besloten zijn 5% aandelenpakket in AZ te verzilveren.
deals.headline: Billy Beane cashes in his 5% of AZ; foundation to hold 100%
deals.summary: Beane exercised the put option on his 5% holding; after the transaction Stichting AZ Alkmaar holds all shares. Beane stays on as an adviser. No price disclosed (a provision for the put was carried in the accounts).

deals.evidence: Financiers uit het AZ Netwerk hebben AZ Holding B.V. in 2023 een kredietfacliteit (rente 2%) beschikbaar gesteld ad € 12 miljoen
deals.headline: AZ network financiers provide EUR 12m credit facility
deals.investor: Financiers from the AZ network (not named)
deals.summary: A EUR 12m credit facility at 2% interest to AZ Holding B.V., running to 31 August 2026; nothing drawn at 30 June 2025.

deals.evidence: lening afgesloten met de NWB Bank voor een bedrag van € 10 miljoen
deals.headline: NWB Bank lends AZ EUR 10m for the new AFAS Stadion roof
deals.summary: A 15-year EUR 10m loan from NWB Bank for rebuilding the stadium roof, guaranteed by the Municipality of Alkmaar. Date not stated in the accounts.

deals.evidence: De gemeente Zaanstad heeft AZ N.V. een lening (3%) beschikbaar gesteld ad maximaal € 10,75 miljoen ten behoeve van het nieuwe AFAS Trainingscomplex
deals.headline: Municipality of Zaanstad lends up to EUR 10.75m for the AFAS Trainingscomplex
deals.summary: A 25-year loan at 3% of up to EUR 10.75m to A.Z. N.V. for the new training complex (opened 2016-17); EUR 4.3m outstanding at 30 June 2025. Signing date not stated.

notes: AZ's 2025/26 accounts (year to 30 June 2026) were not yet published on az.nl on 3 Oct 2026 (last year's came out 7 Oct), so figures are 2024/25: net revenue EUR 59.3m (EUR 59.293m in the accounts), net profit EUR 10.402m, equity EUR 82.3m, pre-tax EUR 14.338m, statutory operating result (bedrijfsresultaat, incl. EUR 29.5m net transfer fees booked as other operating income) EUR 13.287m. The operating result recorded is the club's own measure excluding transfer income and player amortisation (EUR -6.7m). Revenue split as the club reports it (x EUR 1,000): wedstrijdbaten incl. UEFA prize money 24,535; sponsorship 16,324; TV 9,965; merchandising/magazines/internet 1,392; horeca 6,380; player loans/secondment 698 - not re-mapped to matchday/broadcast/commercial. Wages are 'Lonen en salarissen' only (social charges EUR 2.856m and pensions EUR 0.477m are separate lines). Evidence for table figures is the row as a text-layout PDF reader renders it. Ownership: the foundation's 100% is stated as the outcome once Beane's buy-back completes; no page found confirming the completion date or price. Ownership type set to 'other' (a foundation, not a members' association). Leaseweb is the back-of-shirt 'Shirt Partner' from 2025/26 (four seasons); AFAS is the front-of-shirt and stadium naming partner. An earlier EUR 15m financiers' loan to A.Z. Vastgoed B.V. (secured on the stadium) was fully repaid by 30 June 2024 - date of origin not stated, so no deal row. Occupancy 90.5% incl. business seats in 2024/25 and 12,592 season-ticket holders, but no average attendance figure. No valuation found. No social follower counts found on a citable page.

owners.evidence: Deze transactie zal op korte termijn plaatsvinden, waarna Stichting AZ Alkmaar 100% van de aandelen zal houden.
owners.name: Stichting AZ Alkmaar

ownership_summary: AZ is owned through A.Z. Holding B.V. by Stichting AZ Alkmaar, a foundation that took over the shares from DSB Beheer's administrators in 2010. Billy Beane held a stake of up to 5% (via WLBIII LLC) from 2020 and in July 2025 decided to sell it back, after which the foundation is to hold 100%; the club says it remains open to new minority shareholders.
